description: Spek's spectrogram analysis for .NET. Decodes audio with ffmpeg and turns it into columns of dB values, one per pixel, with Spek's palettes, window functions and rulers.
A WinUI 3 control that draws Spek's spectrogram of an audio file with Win2D as it decodes, and saves it as a PNG.
dotnet new template that adds an Odin's Hand in-game test harness plugin to a Valheim (BepInEx) mod.

An in-game test harness for Valheim (BepInEx 5) mods. Launches the real game, loads a disposable character and world, runs your test cases against live game objects, takes screenshots and prints a pass/fail report.
